hints.title: Remainder Modulo Classification
hints.text: Only group sizes modulo batchSize matter for determining batch alignment and fresh donut distribution.

hints.title: Greedy Exact Complement Pairing
hints.text: Groups divisible by batchSize get fresh donuts first, and pairs of remainders that sum to batchSize can be greedily matched.

hints.title: State Search Over Remaining Counts
hints.text: The remaining remainder counts are small enough to memoize remaining frequency states with depth search.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting n groups yields n! possibilities which is infeasible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy pairing reduces the state space of remaining counts to small dimensions solvable via memoization.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate isolates remainders and pairs complements greedily before invoking memoized state transition.
